scripts.postinstall: pnpm run prisma:generate && pnpm run build:packages
scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run build:api && pnpm run build:admin && pnpm run build:uniapp && pnpm run build:web
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @lingdian/common build && pnpm --filter @lingdian/contracts build && pnpm --filter @lingdian/db build && pnpm --filter @lingdian/observability build
scripts.test:all: pnpm --filter @lingdian/common test && pnpm --filter @lingdian/contracts test && pnpm --filter @lingdian/observability test && pnpm --filter @lingdian/api test && pnpm --filter @lingdian/admin test && pnpm --filter @lingdian/web test && pnpm --filter @lingdian/uniapp test && node --test tests/*.test.mjs uniapp/tests/*.test.mjs scripts/*.test.mjs
